details: Failures: Mentor continuation routing/worker-step contract and RetNet contextual web-topic contract. Three interrupted observations have no runtime record or score.

Configuration: Orchestrator routing v6 / graph-index v2, Retriever v7, Researcher v6, Analyst v6 and Mentor v4. Generative roles used the variable openrouter/free route; serving identities were not always observed.
Analyst used legacy vector context; Visualizer used optimized retrieval. Document, index and graph stores were local, vector storage Pinecone, and checkpoints MongoDB.
All 12 completed runtime records lack complete token totals. Runtime attempt reservations were 45 of 54; full effort used 79 of 92, including failures and retries.

retrieval_notes: Measured October 28–29, 2026 UTC on local prepared storage; scoring exported October 30. A is source-only, B graph-assisted, C adds local reranking, and D is the legacy pipeline with different budgets.
Graph-assisted B minus A Precision@10: −1.11 percentage points on development (27 pairs) and +0.71 on frozen (21 pairs). C minus B: −3.33 (18 pairs) and −2.14 (14 pairs).
Fresh-process CPU retrieval-call timing C minus B: +274.266 seconds development (18 pairs), +204.258 seconds frozen (14 pairs); this is not production latency.

Twenty-two of 24 planned measurements completed. Precision uses weighted relevance over ten slots; Recall requires a fully supported source. Labels are AI-assisted/user-endorsed and not independent expert ratings.
limitations: Generated-answer correctness and completeness were not measured. The one attempted judge request returned HTTP 429; its origin and cooldown are unknown. Three further eligible assessments were unstarted.
The configured judge model and endpoint do not establish observed serving identity. Token availability was 0 of 1 attempts for input, output and total; missing is not zero.
The sample is small; source support does not establish answerability. Graph focus remains unresolved, and deployment, cloud-vector and production parity were not established.

retrieval.scope: Local real-model retrieval, fresh processes; no answer generation or current workflow measurement. Raw evidence and case text are private.

arms.A: graph-free source retrieval with shared deterministic lexical/metadata scoring and diversification, model reranker disabled

measurement.timer: CPU fresh-process retrieval-call elapsed seconds per case bundle; excludes startup, normalization, scoring
measurement.precision: weighted relevance 1/0.5/0 over actual first ten unique sources divided by fixed 10; absent slots contribute zero
measurement.recall: unchanged required answer points with at least one fully supported source in actual top ten; partial earns no full credit; unknown absent mappings make unsupported-in-list point unavailable
measurement.development_recall: available observations only; missingness prevents complete-cohort comparisons

provenance.labels: 98 new required pairs AI-assisted and user-endorsed, 77 prior reviewed development pairs, eight prior approved frozen pairs, plus one later point decision; not independent expert or judge ratings
provenance.provenance_limit: Hashes match retained artifacts; they do not establish an independent pre-execution snapshot.

limitations: No generated-answer correctness, current task success, production traffic, or production latency measured.
No statistical significance or global superiority conclusion.
Frozen SVM topic has prior exposure and unproven disambiguation; no true-miss coverage.
D uses a different pipeline and budgets; it is not a matched pre-fix B0.
Early exit and environment details are partly unreconstructable; D validity/resource counters uninstrumented.
Per-case memory peaks and provider/judge tokens unavailable.

anonymized_container_development_example.measure: Completed measured observations with a full in-list witness for the case’s required point
anonymized_container_development_example.source: Derived from the accepted scoring observations identified by the observations hash in provenance; no passage or question is included.

judge.scope: Sanitized partial-pilot operational status derived from the preserved failed invocation; not a generated scorecard or publication manifest.
judge.cause: HTTP 429 observed; response body and rate-limit headers were not retained, so origin and cooldown are unknown.
judge.limitations: No scores or matched judge comparison; no inference from configured to observed serving identity.
